limitations: Existing benchmark frameworks provide evaluation infrastructure, not intelligence or proof of AGI.
software_registry_policy: This machine-readable inventory includes available candidate upstream tools but does NOT authorize installing, copying or testing everything. Existing Plenum incumbent > official released upstream on demand > smallest adapter > build missing. Inherit original upstream validation under its proven conditions, check Plenum import/interface at first use, test only new original capability. No synthetic data substitutes for real-world outcomes.
